reviews.title: Very impressive Cooler
reviews.comment: I recently bought the Geometric Future Model 5 PC case, and wanted to have a unified fan system, so I bought this CPU Cooler to go with it. Love the look of the Cooling block and the fans have a really nice RGB ring around them, although the fans do get a little loud at times.  Also the fans come daisy chained together so it very easy to install into your PC case. Been monitoring the temperature of my CPU (a Ryzen 9 7900x) while doing various task and so far this cooler has done a great job at keeping everything nice and cool. So overall very good value for the money. Also, when i first got the CPU Cooler, i was given the incorrect amount of bracket screws for my motherboard. You are suppose to get 4 Intel screws and 4 AMD screws, but i was given 5 Intel and only 3 AMD. I managed to make it work using the screws of one of my previous CPU coolers but I emailed them on a whim seeing if there was anyway I could get the missing screw and I was impressed by how fast they responded back. Within almost 24 hours, they responded and notified me that they shipped out a replacement set of screws (I can't even get companies like ASUS to respond to  my emails). So overall very impressed by this company and their Customer Service.
reviews.author: Nick O.

reviews.title: Excellent service and product
reviews.comment: The pump is making a terrible noise. Water cooling 420 mm. As if an old compressor refrigerator is working. Moreover, the pump does not start making noise right away, but on the second or third day. I don’t know what this is connected with. I wrote to the official website of Geometric Future, but they never answered me. I had to return the first copy to Amazon because I thought it was a factory defect. I received a new set exactly the same from Amazon. And three days later it also started making noise. It’s terrible. I tried to solve the problem and turned the case to release bubbles and tried to adjust the speed. I noticed that the pump does not whistle at low speeds. At medium speeds from time to time. At full 100% speed, all the time. I will return it and buy something else. It’s a pity, because it fits so perfectly into the case from this brand Mesh 5 P. S. After reporting an issue with the AIO in my Geometric Future case, their support team immediately reached out and provided me with a new 420mm cooling system. I replaced the radiator for the third time, and now the system runs quietly and flawlessly. I am truly impressed by Geometric Future’s customer support — the company shows real care and dedication to both their products and their customers. As a gesture of appreciation for the effort I put into replacing the radiators, they even sent me a nice bonus gift. I couldn’t be happier that, while building my first PC, I chose Geometric Future components. Excellent service, excellent product. Keep up the great work!
reviews.author: dim-deep

reviews.title: Great inexpensive cooler
reviews.comment: Excellent cooler. Simple to install and fans are pre-installed and daisy chained. Quiet and efficient. Would recommend.
reviews.author: Richard J. Ehart

reviews.title: Very effective, but quality control could be better
reviews.comment: The 4-pin to 4-pin cable is faulty, no fan spin if using the long 4-pin to 4-pin segment, the short one works. At full speed the pump is very noisy. At 1800 RMP it is quiet. Cools and looks awesome
